title: Publish public Consensus Receipts on GitHub Pages
instruction: Publish curated public-only Consensus Receipts for findings that passed the Consensus Gate. Show the participating AI models, agent roles, independence groups, harness repositories, Run IDs, and exact harness commit hashes. Do not publish raw assessments, prompts, private logs, secrets, or non-public information. Findings without an accepted Receipt must remain explicitly provisional or Consensus-incomplete.
